turns.text: Hey John! How've you been? Something awesome happened - I'm writing articles about fantasy novels for an online mag. It's so rewarding!
Hey Tim! Congrats on the opportunity to write about what you're into! How did it happen?

Thanks! I found this opportunity on a fantasy lit forum and thought it'd be perfect since I love fantasy. I shared my ideas with the magazine and they liked them! It's been awesome to spread my love of fantasy.
Congratulations! That's awesome. What kind of articles have you been writing?
Thanks! I've been writing about different fantasy novels, studying characters, themes, and making book recommendations.
Awesome! Must be so rewarding to delve into your books and chat about them. Do you have any favorite books you love writing about?
For sure! Harry Potter and Game of Thrones are amazing - I'm totally hooked! I could chat about them forever!

Oh yeah, I remember you telling me about Harry Potter! I've got a funny story. Anthony and I went to this charity thing and ended up in this intense Harry Potter trivia contest. We did alright, but there was this one super-nerd there that took home this as a prize.
That looks great! The signature is sweet! Have you been reading anything?
I've been reading this inspiring book, it reminds me to keep dreaming.
Books can really inspire and help us keep our dreams alive. Keep it up!
Thanks! They really do. I want to keep reaching for new goals.
Have fun with your writing! Catch you later!
Thanks! I'll enjoy writing them. Take care and talk soon!
